page_title: Amical — Open-Source AI Dictation to Type 4x Faster

summary.name: Amical
summary.one_liner: Amical is an open-source, AI-powered dictation app that turns speech into formatted text for any application.
use_cases: Writing messages and social posts by voice
Transcribing jargon-heavy content with custom vocabulary
Hands-free text entry with voice commands
summary.what_it_does:
Amical converts spoken audio into text using AI speech-to-text models. It can auto-format dictation based on the application in use, such as a professional tone for Gmail or a casual one for Instagram. Users can choose cloud-based models or run models locally for more privacy. A custom vocabulary lets it recognize specific terms, jargon, and proper nouns, and custom voice commands and shortcuts support hands-free use. The page claims support for 100+ languages, including mixed-language dictation.</what_it_does>
